title: Unique Games Approximation-Threshold Conjecture
exact_target: Unique Games Conjecture: for every finite CSP and every $\varepsilon>0$, a polynomial-time algorithm achieves within $\varepsilon$ of the approximation threshold beyond which approximation is UGC-hard, and this threshold factor can be efficiently approximated.
